title: Questionnaire-to-Control Mapper + Auto-Remediation Ticket Generator
creator: Jordan Kim
description:
Objective: Build an intake enhancement that automatically maps incoming vendor/customer security questionnaire items (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA and freeform RFI questions) to Redwood platform controls and, where gaps are identified, generates prioritized remediation tickets for engineering with pre-filled context and estimated effort. The feature should reduce manual Triage time for the security team, speed customer responses, and create a persistent audit trail tying questionnaire items to controls and remediation work.

Scope and non-goals: Scope includes: (1) a rules+LLM-assisted mapping engine to align questionnaire items to our control inventory, (2) an API and Console UI surface to review and approve suggested mappings, and (3) a ticket-generation flow that creates Linear (or integrates with Jira) issues with recommended priority and estimate. Non-goals in this ticket: automated legal redlines on DPAs, wholesale contract negotiation flows, or replacing formal compliance attestations.

Design notes: We will combine a deterministic ruleset (regex + taxonomy) with a lightweight LLM scorer to handle ambiguous language in questionnaires. The UI will show: original question, suggested control(s) (with links to internal control doc), confidence score, suggested evidence artifacts, and suggested remediation tasks (title, measured impact, rough estimate points). Users can accept, edit, or reject suggestions before a ticket is created. There will be an admin toggle to enable auto-create mode for low-risk matches (confidence >= 0.9) for high-tier customers.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Engine maps >80% of a held-out set of 500 real questionnaire items to the correct control label (precision >= 85% at suggested top-1), 2) Generated remediation tickets include control reference, suggested owner, and an estimated effort field, 3) UI surfaces suggestion with edit/approve flow and audit log entries for every action, 4) Integration test with Linear create endpoint is validated in staging, 5) Privacy check confirms no persistence of PII in model prompts/logs.

Success metrics (first 90 days): 1) Reduce average time-to-first-response on questionnaires from security team from 48h to <8h for self-serve accounts, 2) Decrease manual ticket creation volume by security from 70% to 20% of items processed by the intake flow, 3) Achieve >60% of customers using the suggested evidence bundle for follow-ups.

Implementation notes: - Control inventory model will initially surface mappings to our existing control catalog (internal Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/controls/catalog). - LLM scoring will run in a private environment; prompts and minimal context will be recorded for audit but PII will be scrubbed. - Backend work: new microservice 'intake-mapper' (ENG) exposing POST /map-questionnaire and POST /generate-tickets endpoints. - Frontend work: Console modal in Security > Requests showing mapping review. - Integrations: Linear API token stored in KMS and scoped. Optional Jira webhook later.

Risks & trade-offs: - Over-reliance on model suggestions could automate incorrect remediations: mitigated by approval step and conservative default thresholds. - Privacy risk: model prompts may include customer text; we will scrub keys and PII and route prompts to private compute in Dedicated/Private deployments. - Operational cost: LLM scoring adds latency/cost; optimize with cached mappings and batch scoring.

Rollout plan: 1) Alpha: internal security + 5 trusted customers (feature flag) to validate mappings and gather feedback (2 weeks), 2) Beta: enable for self-serve accounts with UI review required (4 weeks), 3) GA: add auto-create toggle for enterprise tier and Jira integration (8 weeks).

Stakeholders: Security (Nicole Alvarez), Compliance (Dr. Erik Baum), Engineering owners (ENG-4012: Anika Rao), Console PM (this ticket), Design (Samir Desai).

Links & artifacts: PRD draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Questionnaire+to+Control+Mapper, Console mock: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-mockups, Staging integration test plan: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/intake-mapper-tests, initial implementation spike PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/intake-mapper/pull/18
